current_implementation: Not demonstrated or sufficient as-is for general large compaction; active-contact quadrature/history and general distortion-repair remeshing remain open.
finite_strain_explicit_FEM_strategy: Conditionally suitable; requires integrated contact/history/remeshing development and end-to-end capability gates.

kinematic_estimate.limitation: The current transverse-stress-free problem does not prescribe fixed lateral area. J2 plasticity is isochoric, elastic solid volume can change.

limits: Geometric scaling estimate, not a benchmark, particle count or exact 100 mm mesh.
12.1 mm does not divide 100 mm; periodic geometry must be rebuilt.
The 16-fold work estimate assumes 3-D refinement, CFL timestep proportional to h, fixed duration and linear element cost; excludes contact/replay/IO.

proposed_development_gates.name: 接触継続と履歴場
proposed_development_gates.required: 階層積分・材料座標の履歴、生成消失と分裂合流、周期接触を一貫して扱う
proposed_development_gates.gate: 短い完全再生対照と力・摩擦仕事・残留すべりを比較
proposed_development_gates.fallback: 接触離散化・既存エンジンを比較

proposed_development_gates.name: 活性接触中の再メッシュ
proposed_development_gates.status: 一般の表面更新は未対応
proposed_development_gates.required: 品質回復・塑性状態・質量・速度・周期性・接触履歴の移行
proposed_development_gates.gate: 接触中の圧縮曲げすべりで複数回の更新監査を通す
proposed_development_gates.fallback: 別の再メッシュ/ALE/エンジンを比較

proposed_development_gates.name: 少数粒子の通し実証
proposed_development_gates.required: 圧密・保持・除荷、0.1 MPa圧力ケースとphi30/20/10%変形ケースを分ける
proposed_development_gates.gate: 完走・平衡・体積・仕事・永久変形を監査
proposed_development_gates.fallback: 破綻する機構の担当層を再設計

proposed_development_gates.name: 数値収束
proposed_development_gates.required: 同じ連続形状のメッシュ、CFL、載荷時間、接触厚さと積分精度の感度
proposed_development_gates.gate: 完走した全経路・保持・除荷で比較
proposed_development_gates.fallback: 要素定式化・載荷方法・接触表現を比較

proposed_development_gates.name: 性能と代表性
proposed_development_gates.required: 活性接触と再メッシュの実測性能、サイズ・配置・方向性の確認
proposed_development_gates.gate: 実測値から必要RVEと100 mm仕様の費用を見積る
proposed_development_gates.fallback: 並列化・既存エンジン・多尺度化を比較

proposed_development_gates.name: 100 mmと円柱比較
proposed_development_gates.required: 仕様の周期充填形状、剛体なし/ありを同じ精度で評価
proposed_development_gates.gate: 局所変形・空隙差まで空間収束を確認
proposed_development_gates.fallback: 小セル反復を最終仕様の代替とはしない

decision: Maintain finite-strain FEM as a conditional first choice; do not plan completion by extending the present replay/bisection scheme alone. Demonstrate integrated active contact/history and distortion-repair remeshing before full compaction or scale-up.
